name: Amherst Survival Center Community Meals
description: Free hot lunch made fresh on site at 138 Sunderland Rd., North Amherst, to eat in the dining room or take to go. No registration is needed.

requirements.text: All are welcome; no registration necessary. Meals are served Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday.

unknowns: Meal hours differ on the page: the meals section says 12-2:30pm, while the site footer lists Community Center & Meals hours as 12-3pm.
The page does not state a service area; the county is the meal site's location, not a residency rule.
